turn_prompts: Write the fixed candidate files only in the host workspace. When provisioning Debian packages in environment/Dockerfile, switch the default Debian APT sources from HTTP to HTTPS before apt-get update; the controlled build network permits HTTPS egress only. Call harbor_validate_candidate for structured diagnostics; submit no candidate bytes in prose.

Use the same fenced workspace to correct only diagnostics bound to the candidate and frozen VerificationContract. When that contract invokes test.sh through sh, both test.sh and solution/solve.sh must be POSIX sh compatible: do not use set -o pipefail, bash arrays, [[, or other Bash-only syntax.
Call harbor_validate_candidate with a passing candidate; the host captures the immutable snapshot.
